existingDispositions.rationale: Experimental health-behavior synthesis supports bounded self-efficacy changes preceding intentions, conditional on valued behavior and actual feasibility.
Ease/control and capability are not one dimension; the self-efficacy experimental meta-analysis cannot automatically validate every external-constraint PBC component.
PSY-008 permits beneficial outcomes; a generic positive fear effect is too broad. Likelihood/threat and elicited fear must be independently distinguished.
Perceived severity is distinct from fear, and strong fear messages do not isolate the severity appraisal causally.
Protective-response usefulness can support intention; content-based meta-analysis and broad theory do not identify all latent efficacy contrasts.
Coping capability and helplessness may overlap inversely under matching reference scope; sources do not independently identify this causal direction.
Perceived available support may aid coping confidence, but cited buffering and need-support theories do not isolate this exact belief-to-belief causal effect.
Preserve governed pathway-segment identity, but broad climate/health synthesis has not been aligned to supply-continuity → personal control with exact population/timing.
Communicated severity is distinct from perceived severity; native references are a behavior-design framework and information-threat policy, not exact trial evidence.
Information about efficacy differs from belief in efficacy; original framework/policy sources do not test the exact target.
Action-guidance completeness is not actual capability/opportunity or confidence. COM-B is a framework, not a completeness manipulation trial.
Shared group capability belief and individual belief in response effectiveness have different referents. Collective-action synthesis largely concerns participation associations.
Override availability can be unrecognized or unusable; NIST framework is normative design guidance, not a measured psychological effect.
Number/specificity of privacy controls does not establish perceived influence; usability, comprehension, permissions and risk differ.

gapQuestions.rationale: Successful composite appraisal manipulations support a research direction, not an isolated probability effect; relevant valence/coping conditions required.
Factorial threat×efficacy behavior findings do not target the exact severity→fear edge; no formal moderator.
Shared CF-0002; opportunity, incentive and criterion alter measurement; no new duplicate issue.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Controllability and helplessness are independent inverse causal forces when scored from the same reversed item.
gapQuestions.rationale: Same measurement cannot produce two independent causal contributions.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Coping self-efficacy independently reduces expected futility.
gapQuestions.rationale: Same research question as REL-PSY-011; no duplicate candidate.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Support → coping confidence → helplessness is a mediated pathway.
gapQuestions.rationale: Neither graph reachability nor trial regression supplies pathway-specific identification.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Subjective uncertainty produces acute physiological stress.
gapQuestions.rationale: Learning-model uncertainty is inferred; exact Driver measurement and biological stress endpoint unresolved. No fitted latent model output labelled empirical Driver.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: State uncertainty is intolerance of uncertainty.
gapQuestions.rationale: Momentary lack of confidence differs from aversive stable response to uncertainty.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Uncertainty disclosure always increases subjective uncertainty.
gapQuestions.rationale: Disclosure amount, objective uncertainty and experienced confidence are different; INF-F03 source evidence may be consulted later, not revised.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Mastery, feedback or coping-training package changes general self-efficacy.
gapQuestions.rationale: Task-specific operation and independently measured capability required; enduring general change not assumed.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: A contingent noise-termination protocol increases perceived task control relative to a noncontingent protocol.
gapQuestions.rationale: Discovery for EA-CAND-PSY-LAYER-0003 only; not a separate causal edge or human vote.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Uncontrollable noise induces expected action ineffectiveness.
gapQuestions.rationale: Feeling-helpless item and expected future futility differ; preserve Study 1 non-detection and Study 2 effect.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: The manipulation-check score causes the outcome because both changed.
gapQuestions.rationale: Intervention randomization does not randomize its measured mediator; simultaneous reports cannot identify this direction.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Sleep loss changes subjective probability of a specified hazard.
gapQuestions.rationale: Search often finds risk preference/gambling rather than probability; reuse existing sleep-loss identity if an exact effect later survives, no BIO-F01 changes.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Cultural context moderates perceived-control effects on intention.
gapQuestions.rationale: Country labels and measurement noninvariance do not supply exact Cultural moderator; no external Family audit.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Social inclusion or disaster support changes coping confidence.
gapQuestions.rationale: Support/context bundles and longitudinal selection require exact evidence; existing REL-PSY-016/ENV-044 issues reused.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Official threat policy proves every message raises perceived severity.
gapQuestions.rationale: Policy identity, compliant content, received exposure and effect are separate.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Capability belief and perceived behavioral control are interchangeable.
gapQuestions.rationale: Related measures with internal/external dimensions; require matched behavior, agency, opportunity and measurement.

gapQuestions.questionOrDisposition: Bayesian uncertainty inferred from task behavior is direct empirical evidence of measured subjective uncertainty.
gapQuestions.rationale: Model inference cannot substitute for construct observation or mediation identification.
